author: silver state times
title: Nevada to face New Mexico in Mountain West Championship play-in game Thursday
text:
Nevada will take on New Mexico in a play-in game at the Credit Union 1 Mountain West Championship, according to a May 20 announcement. The matchup is set for Thursday, May 21, with first pitch scheduled for 6:05 p.m. at Sloan Park in Mesa, Arizona.
The winner of this game will advance to the four-team, double-elimination portion of the tournament and face top-seeded San Diego State on Friday afternoon. All games during the championship will be available via streaming on the Mountain West Network and MW App, as well as broadcast on KPLY 630 AM and The Varsity Network app.
New Mexico enters the contest with a record of 28-22-1 but has lost seven of its last eleven games. Khalil Walker leads their offense with a .359 batting average and three home runs. On the pitching side, Cristian Mogen is expected to start; he holds a record of one win and two losses with an earned run average of 6.54 across over sixty-three innings pitched this season.
Nevada leads New Mexico in their all-time series by six games and recently won two out of three matchups against them in Albuquerque from April 17-19. In tournament history between these teams at the Mountain West Championship, however, New Mexico holds five wins compared to Nevada’s one across previous meetings.
This marks Nevada’s tenth appearance at the conference championship since joining in 2013; they have reached the title game once before but are still seeking their first championship win. Last year’s tournament saw Nevada play more than eight hours over two extra-inning games during a single day.
